items.quote: At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt
items.claim: At evening, the Israelites will have the knowledge that the LORD has liberated them from Egypt

items.quote: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD
items.claim: In the morning, the Israelites will witness the glory of the LORD

items.quote: the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat
items.claim: The LORD will provide flesh to eat in the evening

items.quote: and in the morning bread to the full
items.claim: Bread will be provided to satiety in the morning
